hard.reason: This validated package covers direct inspection of complete numeric square matrices only. Six easy sources ask for one matrix; two moderate sources classify three matrices independently. No hard source or verified hard extension is present. Larger matrices or larger coefficients alone do not establish hard difficulty. Symbolic parameter conditions, matrix products, or transformed matrices introduce an unvalidated task or extra prerequisite and are excluded from this version. This is a bounded capability exception, not proof of mathematical impossibility. Reopen on new hard source evidence or a validated extension.

finite_domain: Each matrix independently maps distinct nonzero source-value groups injectively to the 22 integers in [-11,11] excluding zero. Zero locations, dimensions, equality relations and bank profile remain fixed. Sampling deduplicates complete mathematical tasks, ignores seed/identity/option order, and raises on a bounded search failure. No proven global exhaustion; current shortages are feasible.
